summary: Full semantic review and corrections complete with local schema, script, CLI, metrics and diagram validation.
findings: Replaced stale releases and nonexistent Helm repository with pinned official1.16/0.37/0.29/0.72 manifests; corrected Dashboard readonly/full and current feature flags.
Corrected definition-vs-execution, typed Results, namespace-local references and PVC/trust-boundary guidance.
Replaced archived Kaniko/broken CLI images with six fully connected Tasks; explicit BuildKit rootless prerequisites and candidate-only publishing.
Removed direct parameter substitution into shell, arbitrary webhook repos/commands and privileged external-PR path; fixed full-SHA/repository filters and per-Task IAM identities.
Corrected scan error propagation, emitted image digest/results, missing Task references, RWO scheduling and finally skip/timeout semantics.
Corrected SLSA formatter mapping, real Chains KMS/ECR identity chain, async Pipeline provenance and separate CI/cryptographic/policy approval checks.
Replaced unsafe GitOps auto-push claims and unverified-key placeholders with explicit reviewed digest promotion; distinguished ArgoCD synchronization from kubelet image pulls.
Replaced destructive all-cluster cleanup snippets with scope/terminal/completion/retention/archive-aware review; documented actualPVCautocleanupmodes.
Updated metric names/statuses/port, weighted duration calculation, noncancelled failure ratio and absence alerts; removed false no-webhook-event outage claims.
Updated both quizzes and12diagrams; fixed mobile toolbar clipping insharedproductionbuildnormalizer.
